POLITICS

How to join City Boy Movement

Membership registration is handled by the national City Boy Movement platform. This chapter website provides a direct link to that platform.

October 29, 2026 · CBM OGUN

Evergreen guide · CBM OGUN

Membership registration is handled by the national City Boy Movement platform. This chapter website provides a direct link to that platform.

Start on the national website

  1. Open the national registration page using the button below.
  2. Follow the instructions and provide the information requested on that platform.
  3. Select Ogun State, your LGA and ward where the registration flow asks for them.
  4. Review the national platform’s terms and privacy information before submitting.

Any account, identity verification or membership-card questions should be directed to the national platform. This Ogun chapter website does not manage member records.
